Later batches (nursing homes 2028, dental 2030) will be served the same way. Killed by government certification plus incumbent CMS vendors.

name: E-invoicing / "digitálny poštár" for SMEs (from 1 Jan 2027)
text:
- **E-invoicing / "digitálny poštár" for SMEs (from 1 Jan 2027).**
  - The trigger is strong: VAT payers must issue invoices and report data through a certified provider, non-VAT payers must be able to receive them, and there is a no-fine period only until 30 Jun 2027.
  - It is killed by saturation: the Finance Administration register lists 77 certified providers, there are comparison sites (epostari.sk lists 166 offerings), and accounting vendors such as Stormware/POHODA and KROS build it in.
  - Sources:
    - https://www.digitalnipostari.sk/zoznam-postarov
    - https://www.epostari.sk/
    - https://www.podnikajte.sk/pripravovane-zmeny-v-legislative/efaktura-od-2027
    - https://www.stormware.sk/dnload/E-book_1_E-fakturacia_SK.pdf

name: Waste-generator electronic records and ISOH quarterly reporting
text: - **Waste-generator electronic records and ISOH quarterly reporting.** Killed by ENVITA (INISOFT), Envisys, ESPIK, Envis, Envirotree and BeSoft, which all already market 2027-ready waste records.

name: Accommodation foreign-guest reporting to police
text:
- **Accommodation foreign-guest reporting to police.** Killed because guest-register software is already part of almost all programs on the market, plus the official ePolice e-form and import of the provider's own register.
  - Sources:
    - https://www.podnikajte.sk/zakonne-povinnosti-podnikatela/hlasenie-pobytu-cudzincov
    - https://www.slovensko.sk/sk/zivotne-situacie/zivotna-situacia/_hlasenie-kratkodobeho-pobytu-c/

name: EUDR due diligence for wood
text:
- **EUDR due diligence for wood.** Killed because Slovakia is low-risk, the regime is simplified and postponed (the exact current dates were not re-verified in this run), and many EUDR SaaS vendors exist.
  - Source: https://www.naturpack.sk/content/04/povinnosti-hospodarskych-subjektov-a-obchodnikov-podla-eudr-naradenia-europskej-unie-proti-globalnemu-odlesnovan.pdf

name: Guest registration and tourist-tax sync for private room renters
text: - **Guest registration and tourist-tax sync for private room renters**: killed by AJPES eTurizem. A single daily submission reaches the police, municipalities, tourist boards and the statistics office, and eTurizem takes XML imports and a web service that PMS and channel managers already use. Sources: https://www.pzs.si/javno/gk/Zbor_gospodarjev/2018/Register%20nastanitvenih%20obratov%20in%20poro%C4%8Danje.pdf, https://www.soca-valley.com/sl/poslovne-strani/turisticna-taksa-in-prijava-gostov/

name: Waste evidence-list (evidenčni list) automation
text: - **Waste evidence-list (evidenčni list) automation**: killed by the state system ARSO IS-Odpadki. It supports e-signing, collectors completing lists for senders under authorisation, and XML import from local systems, and collectors already run their own software. Sources: https://www.gov.si/assets/organi-v-sestavi/ARSO/Odpadki/Evidencni-listi/DO110_ARSO_Odpadki_UporabniskaNavodila_5_22_21022020.pdf, https://www.gov.si/assets/organi-v-sestavi/ARSO/Odpadki/Porocilo-o-nastalih-odpadkih-in-zagotovitvi-ravnanja-z-njimi-ODP-nastajanje/Navodila-2025_ODP-nastajanje_aplikacija-IS-Odpadki.pdf

name: Veterinary antimicrobial-use reporting
text: - **Veterinary antimicrobial-use reporting**: killed by the government application CIS VET (UVHVVR) and a small buyer base. Sources: https://www.uradni-list.si/glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/2023-01-2416/uredba-o-izvajanju-delegirane-uredbe-eu-v-zvezi-z-zahtevami-za-zbiranje-podatkov-o-obsegu-prodaje-in-uporabi-protimikrobnih-zdravil-pri-zivalih, https://www.gov.si/zbirke/storitve/registracija-dejavnosti-o-preskrbi-veterinarskih-organizacij/

name: B2B e-invoicing (ZIERDED, mandatory 1 Jan 2028)
text: - **B2B e-invoicing (ZIERDED, mandatory 1 Jan 2028)**: free state app miniBlagajna, e-invoice exchange providers, PEPPOL access points, and ERP and accounting vendors. Sources: https://www.gov.si/novice/2025-10-23-drzavni-zbor-sprejel-zakon-o-izmenjavi-elektronskih-racunov-in-drugih-elektronskih-dokumentov/, https://www.pwc.com/si/sl/aktualno/Zakon-o-izmenjavi-elektronskih-racunov-in-drugih-elektronskih-dokumentov.html

name: Working-time records (ZEPDSV-A/B)
text: - **Working-time records (ZEPDSV-A/B)**: crowded attendance-software market. ZEPDSV-B (23 Apr 2025) eased the rules, and electronic records are compulsory only for employers that have been fined. Sources: https://unija.com/sl/spremembe-pri-evidentiranju-delovnega-casa-od-23-aprila-dalje/, https://www.gov.si/novice/2024-12-02-presezeno-stevilo-ugotovljenih-krsitev-pri-vodenju-evidenc-delovnega-casa-ze-v-letu-2024/

name: Fisheries catch documentation / EU export paperwork
text: - **Fisheries catch documentation / EU export paperwork:** the Noro e-port digital Catch Documentation System (launched 2021, the first in the Pacific) and EU TRACES (Solomon Islands registered since 2015) already cover this, and the buyers are a few large processors (e.g. SolTuna). Sources: https://pina.com.fj/2021/07/23/noro-port-first-e-port-in-the-pacific-introduces-digital-catch-documents-and-tracing/, https://www.atuna.com/?p=92092

name: Customs broker declaration prep
text: - **Customs broker declaration prep:** ASYCUDA World is the government system and offers online pre-clearance. Scanned supporting documents have been mandatory since Dec 2020. There are very few brokers. Sources: https://www.sibconline.com.sb/?p=13753, https://asycuda.org/wp-content/uploads/casestudy-solomonislands.pdf

name: Tax/payroll filing for SMEs
text: - **Tax/payroll filing for SMEs:** IRD E-Tax already handles PAYE, Goods Tax and Sales Tax filing and internet-banking payment. Generic Xero/MYOB plus local accountants cover the rest. Source: https://www.ird.gov.sb/

name: - None in the usual sense. The constraint here is market size, not competition
text: - None in the usual sense. The constraint here is market size, not competition.

name: Airline manifest and ticket-price reporting to SOMCAS
text: - **Airline manifest and ticket-price reporting to SOMCAS:** rejected. There are very few buyers, and airlines already rely on their departure-control and GDS vendors (Amadeus, SITA and similar) plus the free government portal.

name: Government financial management (SFMIS invoice tracking and payroll)
text: - **Government financial management (SFMIS invoice tracking and payroll):** rejected. It is a government-internal system that already has digital signatures and payroll integration, and is procured through donor-funded tenders (GTAI lists a tax-automation consulting tender). This is enterprise/government procurement, not indie software.

name: - None identified, but the market was not researched deeply enough to judge
text: - None identified, but the market was not researched deeply enough to judge.

name: COIDA injury-on-duty medical claims (healthcare providers → Compensation Fund / CompEasy)
text:
- **COIDA injury-on-duty medical claims (healthcare providers → Compensation Fund / CompEasy).** The pain is extreme: average payment time is about 347 days, and practitioners refuse COIDA patients. But the bottleneck is the Fund's administration and payment, which software cannot fix. Intermediaries such as **CompSol** already fund and manage claims, and billing agents abound.
  - https://samedical.org/downloads/coid/coid_feb_2021.pdf
  - https://pmg.org.za/files/210421SAMA.pdf
  - https://www.moonstone.co.za/compensation-fund-vs-netcare-high-court-judgment-exposes-deep-fault-lines/

name: EPR reporting for producers
text:
- **EPR reporting for producers.** **PROs** (e.g. eWASA, plus the packaging PROs) take on registration and reporting for members, the 2025 amendments are only proposed, and smaller producers mainly pay fees through their PRO.
  - https://ewasa.org/resources/epr-waste-legislation-and-regulations-south-africa
  - https://www.iges.or.jp/sites/default/files/2026-07/3.%20EPR%20models%20and%20lessons%20from%20South%20Africa.pdf

name: CBAM carbon-data pack for SME exporters
text: - **CBAM carbon-data pack for SME exporters** (first pass scored it 4/10). Korea Customs Service distributes a free CBAM-PASS emissions calculator, and the ministry funds on-site measurement consulting plus verification (support expanded from 110 to 185 firms). Glassdome and Eco365.Ai cover paid needs. Sources: https://www.fnnews.com/news/202506101016526321 ; https://www.heraldk.com/article/2026032903042640323 ; https://cbamguide.com/news/2026-08-20-korea-exporters-carbon-data-survey/

text: - **Apartment unit fire self-inspection (세대점검)**: killed by 아파트아이, whose mobile 세대점검 has run since 2023 and serves about 1.6m households. 아파트너 is also supported. Sources: https://v.daum.net/v/20251210005625733 ; https://www.hapt.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=164214

text: - **Allbaro waste e-manifests**: killed by Upbox automatic manifest linking, waste ERPs (ERPKOREA) and Allbaro's official ERP-integration guide. Sources: https://www.mt.co.kr/future/2024/07/26/2024072610083215310 ; https://www.allbaro.or.kr/01_wsf/wsf_tran_intro.vm ; http://www.erpkorea.com/erp.php

name: Silson24 clinic and pharmacy claim integration
text: - **Silson24 clinic and pharmacy claim integration**: participation is low (clinics and pharmacies 26.8% linked as of May 2026). But the gatekeepers are the EMR vendors, which the government is pressuring with FTC review and new fines, so there is no entry point for a solo vendor. Sources: https://dailypharm.com/user/news/338363 ; https://biz.newdaily.co.kr/site/data/html/2025/10/22/2025102200207.html

name: Foreign-worker EPS administration
text: - **Foreign-worker EPS administration**: the next-generation EPS government system auto-loads documents, and 행정사 handle the rest. Source: https://www.moel.go.kr/news/enews/report/enewsView.do?news_seq=13913

text: - **Freight performance reporting (화물운송실적신고)**: in force since 2013 with burden-reduction exemptions, and covered by freight information networks. Source: https://www.molit.go.kr/USR/policyTarget/dtl.jsp?idx=499

Sources: https://www.kbz.co.kr/ ; https://xn--ob0bs6v15a363c.com/ ; https://m.news.nate.com/view/20251222n26025 ; http://www.jinpos.co.kr/?param=bus

text: - **K-beauty multi-market regulatory registration**: the market is large (28,412 responsible sellers), but Cosmure, CertiCos (CDRI), COOA and Beauty Intelligence are all active, plus government-subsidised KCII consulting. Sources: https://cosmorning.com/mobile/article.html?no=52185 ; https://www.cncnews.co.kr/news/article.html?no=11322 ; https://www.cncnews.co.kr/news/article.html?no=6970 ; https://beautyintelligence.kr/en ; https://www.beautynury.com/news/view/110449/cat/10

name: Digital Tax Stamp compliance tooling for importers
text: - **Digital Tax Stamp compliance tooling for importers.** The DTS (live from 1 July 2025) is run by SSRA and its stamp vendor, who handle stamp issuance, scanning and verification. Third-party software has no role. Source: [Orbitax](https://orbitax.com/news/country/article/South-Sudan-implements-an-elec_a9dad631-8bfe-409d-83c5-b1dc0c132ff9), [Kenya Times](https://thekenyatimes.com/latest-kenya-times-news/south-sudan-unveils-new-digital-tax-system-with-transition-deadline/).

name: SSRA eTax filing assistant for SMEs
text: - **SSRA eTax filing assistant for SMEs.** Killed by the **SSRA eTax portal itself**, by cheap local accountants, and by SMEs' inability to pay foreign SaaS. Source: [Eye Radio](https://www.eyeradio.org/revenue-authority-orders-e-tax-use-warns-against-manual-payments).

name: - None identified. The market is too small to attract competition; the problem i
text: - None identified. The market is too small to attract competition; the problem is a lack of buyers, not rivals.

name: Waste memoria compliance router
text: - **Waste memoria compliance router** (was 4.5/10 in the first pass). Under the Coordination Commission agreement under Ley 7/2022, hazardous-waste producers whose identification documents are in the e-SIR repository have fulfilled the memoria obligation, and several regions exempt them. Eurofins EcoGestor and others already generate the archive and memoria and integrate e-SIR and DIWASS. Sources: https://medioambiente.castillalamancha.es/sites/default/files/2026-06/PRODUCTOR_obligaciones.pdf, https://www.caib.es/sites/residus/es/acuerdo_comision_memoria_anual_productores_residuos/, https://www.eurofins.com/es-es/servicios-medioambientales/ecogestor/residuos/

name: Rent-a-car SES reporting
text: - **Rent-a-car SES reporting:** rental software and the net2rent-style automatic SES web-service submission; AECA guidance (https://www.aecarent.com/noticias-ID643.htm, https://net2rent.com/guia-rapida-envio-automatico-de-datos-a-ses-hospedajes/).

name: NRUA annual rental deposit
text: - **NRUA annual rental deposit:** the free N2 app from the Colegio de Registradores; Partee and Chekin guides and tools; annual (https://partee.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Manual-de-instalacion-y-creacion-de-Depositos-de-Arrendamientos-en-aplicacion-N2.pdf).

name: Solar / shared self-consumption legalisation (RDL 7/2026 "gestor de autoconsumo")
text: - **Solar / shared self-consumption legalisation (RDL 7/2026 "gestor de autoconsumo"):** Wattwin, PylonData, Elecsum "+Legal", Hesstec, SolarDirecto (https://wattwin.com/, https://elecsum.com/es/comunidades-energeticas/legal/, https://cuencasolar.es/blog/el-nuevo-rdl-7-2026-crea-la-figura-del-gestor-de-autoconsumo-para-instalaciones-compartidas/).

name: Pest control / legionella records
text: - **Pest control / legionella records:** iGEO ERP (800+ companies), EviSane (https://gust.com/companies/igeoerp).

name: Plastic-packaging tax (mod. 592)
text: - **Plastic-packaging tax (mod. 592):** AHORA and Goldensoft ERP modules; Circulr for refunds (https://ahora.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/154000210673-erp-impuesto-sobre-el-pl%C3%A1stico-no-reutilizable, https://circulr.es/blog/recuperar-impuesto-plastico-modelo-a22).

name: CBAM / EUDR for Spanish importers
text: - **CBAM / EUDR for Spanish importers:** pan-EU vendors (osapiens, Freyr and others); the 50 t CBAM threshold exempts most SMEs (https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/cambio-climatico/temas/cbam/actores-cbam.html, https://osapiens.com/es/preguntas-frecuentes-eudr).

name: Electrical CIE multi-region filing
text: - **Electrical CIE multi-region filing:** regional systems differ (SERIE, OGE, TECI), but installers mostly work in one region, and CYPE and dmELECT produce the documents (https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/sites/default/files/inline-files/2025/06/Manual_Usuario_TECI.pdf).

name: Electronic DeCA
text: - **Electronic DeCA:** bluecmr, logitrack, kaleidotrans, metotrans, plus the free government tool.

name: Vet PRESVET
text: - **Vet PRESVET:** clinic software already automates it (~80% of vets report via web services).

name: SILICIE
text: - **SILICIE:** AEAT system since 2020; ERP vendors; small producers exempt.

name: Packaging declaration (RD 1055/2022)
text: - **Packaging declaration (RD 1055/2022):** Ecoembes and Ecovidrio portals.

name: Digital time tracking

text: - **Food-waste law plans (Ley 1/2025):** mostly one-off and generic; consultancies and food banks provide guides.

text: - B2B e-invoicing (RD 238/2026; Order in force 1 Oct 2026, so obligations from 1 Oct 2027 and 1 Oct 2028): free AEAT solution plus b2brouter, Docuten, Sage and others.

text: - SES.HOSPEDAJES traveller registry (Chekin, Avirato, PMSs).

text: - FUNDAE subsidised-training notifications.

name: - Farm digital notebooks for farmers (oSIGris, Agroptima, VisualNACert, Hispatec
text: - Farm digital notebooks for farmers (oSIGris, Agroptima, VisualNACert, Hispatec); only the contractor niche is kept above.

name: Tea bought-leaf factory supplier payouts and Tea Board returns
text: - **Tea bought-leaf factory supplier payouts and Tea Board returns.** About 450 private bought-leaf factories make this a real workflow. It is killed by AgriGEN ERP, which specifically automates green-leaf procurement, monthly leaf-rate updates and deductions. Brokers' systems also already send tea-manufacturer invoices to RAMIS (since 1 May 2026). Sources: https://lankabusinessonline.com/?p=43897, https://www.vatupdate.com/2026/05/14/sri-lanka-expands-national-e-invoicing-pilot-with-web-api-integration-for-vat-data-transmission/

name: EPF/ETF monthly e-return automation
text: - **EPF/ETF monthly e-return automation.** E-returns are compulsory for employers with 50+ staff, and since 30 Apr 2025 uploads go only through the EPF Online Services System. It is killed by the many local payroll and HRIS packages that already generate EPF/ETF files (individual vendors not verified in this session), and by the CBSL–Labour Department integration project. Sources: https://epf.lk/?p=171, https://www.peoplesbank.lk/roastoth/2025/03/Discontinuation-Notice-of-Accepting-EPF-via-Peoples-net.pdf

name: NMRA pharmacy licence renewal helper
text: - **NMRA pharmacy licence renewal helper.** Renewal is annual, and NMRA's own online-only portal (since 21 Apr 2026) is the substitute. Low frequency. Source: https://www.nmra.gov.lk/announcements

name: EU CATCH catch-certificate tool for Sri Lankan seafood exporters
text: - **EU CATCH catch-certificate tool for Sri Lankan seafood exporters.** CATCH is mandatory only for EU importers and member-state authorities. Non-EU operators can use it voluntarily, and paper certificates are accepted with a scan until 2028. The flag-state authority (DFAR) validates certificates, and few exporters exist. Sources: https://www.seafoodsource.com/news/environment-sustainability/new-digital-catch-certificate-goes-into-effect-in-eu, https://agrinfo.eu/book-of-reports/eu-catch-certification-scheme/

name: PDPA compliance (DPO, DPIA, breach logs, ROPA), effective 1 Jan 2027 under Gazette 2498/16
text: - **PDPA compliance (DPO, DPIA, breach logs, ROPA), effective 1 Jan 2027 under Gazette 2498/16.** The deadline is real, but this is the "generic compliance" trap. Competitors include the local Xapi PDPA playbook and framework, Securiti, ISMS.online, consentstack, flexyconsent, EY Colombo and law firms. Sources: https://www.ft.lk/front-page/Data-protection-compliance-regime-takes-effect-on-1-Jan-2027/44-795776, https://www.sundaytimes.lk/260906/business-times/xapi-launches-practical-pdpa-compliance-playbook-655571.html, https://securiti.ai/pt-br/solutions/sri-lankas-personal-data-protection-act-2022

name: Apparel exporter EU sustainability and e-invoicing
text: - **Apparel exporter EU sustainability and e-invoicing.** Large groups dominate the sector, buy through enterprise procurement and are already in the RAMIS pilot (screened through the e-invoicing searches, no separate search).

name: E-invoice connector for Sudanese SMEs
text: - **E-invoice connector for Sudanese SMEs.** Killed by the Taxation Chamber's own free executable client, combined with having no way to collect payment.

text: - None identified (not researched in depth).

name: Payroll compliance (wage tax, AOV and other payroll filings)
text: - **Payroll compliance (wage tax, AOV and other payroll filings):** killed by **Celery Payroll**, which offers a Suriname module with local partners Kenswil & Co. and Baboem N.V., and by **SalisFlow** from Castelen Systems in Paramaribo, which has a free tier. Sources: https://www.celerypayroll.com/en/?p=1878, https://sourceforge.net/software/product/SalisFlow/

name: Customs brokerage on ASYCUDA
text: - **Customs brokerage on ASYCUDA:** killed by timing and government ownership. The ASYCUDA upgrade has been underway since 2023, and the Single Window is planned for December 2027 (indicative) and December 2028 (definitive). text:
- **ASYCUDAWorld declaration pre-fill for customs brokers.** ASYCUDAWorld has been mandatory for all import and export declarations since 1 Oct 2025, so the trigger is real. The idea was killed for three reasons:
  - The buyer pool is tiny: about 34 registered customs representatives.
  - ASYCUDA is free and donor-supported (UNCTAD and the World Bank CARs-4 project), with broker training already provided.
  - Large importers file through their own staff.
  Sources:

text: - **Customs declaration helper for brokers/importers.** Killed by **ASYCUDA World / TileSW**, the UNCTAD-built state system (single window live since Feb 2021, linking partner agencies and TradeInvest). Sources: https://www.santos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/TL-Suppliers-Info-slides-for-engagement-May-2022-Rev-2.pdf , https://insights.worley.com/case-studies/mapping-and-development-of-industry-capabilities-in-timor-leste

Sources: https://verigates.bureauveritas.com/node/61, https://tfadatabase.org/en/uploads/thematicdiscussiondocument/Mise_en_oeuvre_de_lAFE-par_le_CNFE_Togo_Corrige.pdf

name: Payroll and social filings as a standalone product
text: - **Payroll and social filings as a standalone product:** made largely unnecessary by the CNSS's own Excel import for the DRC, plus existing payroll packages and accountants. Kept above only at 3/10.

name: - None confirmed in Togo. For e-invoicing, the threat is a free OTR platform plu
text: - None confirmed in Togo. For e-invoicing, the threat is a free OTR platform plus international vendors (EDICOM) and regional accounting SaaS (CassKai), not saturation.

name: Consumption Tax / SME bookkeeping compliance
text: - **Consumption Tax / SME bookkeeping compliance:** Killed by Xero/MYOB plus local accounting firms. 15% CT, TOP 100,000 registration threshold; I found no 2025–26 e-invoicing mandate. Sources: https://taxatlas.io/country/tonga/vat-sales-tax, https://aviaanaccounting.com/accounting-firms-in-tonga/

name: Customs entry automation
text: - **Customs entry automation:** Killed by ASYCUDA World (UNCTAD, government-run) and the Tonga Trade Portal. Brokers are optional and few. Sources: https://tonga.tradeportal.org/procedure/153?l=en, https://matangitonga.to/tag/customs?page=1

name: Quarantine/biosecurity records
text: - **Quarantine/biosecurity records:** Killed by the donor-funded government Quarantine Management Information System. Source: https://pacerplus.org/tag/committee-on-sps-and-tbt/

name: - SME accounting/tax (Xero, MYOB, local firms)
text: - SME accounting/tax (Xero, MYOB, local firms).

name: E-invoicing compliance tool
text: - **E-invoicing compliance tool:** there is no mandate. T&T's model is "post-audit", with no required format or infrastructure (Thomson Reuters regulatory tracker: https://europe.thomsonreuters.com/de/compliance/regulatory-updates/trinidad-and-tobago).

name: Amusement Gaming Tax filing helper
text: - **Amusement Gaming Tax filing helper:** filing became online-only through the free IRD e-Tax portal from April 1, 2026. It is a tiny niche and the change happens once (https://www.finance.gov.tt/media-release-inland-revenue-division-ird-announces-mandatory-online-filing-for-amusement-gaming-tax-returns/).

name: General SME payroll / statutory deductions
text: - **General SME payroll / statutory deductions:** already covered by Paymaster, TTPay, Payroll123, Payroll Control, Odoo VedTech, and global EOR providers.

name: - T&T payroll engines (see above)
text: - T&T payroll engines (see above).

name: - BIR e-Tax return preparation, which accountants and the free portal already co
text: - BIR e-Tax return preparation, which accountants and the free portal already cover.

name: E-invoicing SaaS for liberal professions and service SMEs
text: - **E-invoicing SaaS for liberal professions and service SMEs:** killed by Finco, efacturetn, Hesabi, Shazler, Axiom Suite, Novatis, elfatoora.digital and Sage, all launched for the 2026 services extension.

name: Standalone TEJ withholding-certificate generator
text: - **Standalone TEJ withholding-certificate generator:** killed by Hesabi, Jibaya, BPS Solutions and E-Comptable.

name: CNSS declaration automation
text: - **CNSS declaration automation:** killed by payroll software and the Odoo `cnss_declaration` module (https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/18.0/cnss_declaration).

name: Pharmacy CNAM claims tool
text: - **Pharmacy CNAM claims tool:** the real problem is CNAM payment arrears and a suspended contract (tiers payant suspended Oct/Dec 2025, threatened again from 1 Jul 2026), not workflow. Sources: https://lapresse.tn/2025/10/28/plus-de-90-des-pharmacies-se-plaignent-du-retard-de-paiement-de-la-cnam/ and https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202606260440.html

name: Labour-law (Law 2025-9) compliance tool
text: - **Labour-law (Law 2025-9) compliance tool:** a one-time conversion of contracts. Source: https://managers.tn/2025/03/14/cdd-automatiquement-convertis-en-cdi-une-nouvelle-loi-entre-en-vigueur

name: - Core El Fatoora / TEIF invoicing SaaS (see the competitors listed above)
text: - Core El Fatoora / TEIF invoicing SaaS (see the competitors listed above).

name: - TEJ certificate generation
text: - TEJ certificate generation.

name: Environmental-consultancy multi-client tracker (TABS/MoTAT/Sıfır Atık/permits)
text: - **Environmental-consultancy multi-client tracker (TABS/MoTAT/Sıfır Atık/permits):** Çevre Yazılım (cevreyazilimi.com) and Temsil Çevre Danışmanlık ve Yazılım already sell modular consultancy software. Seyir Mobil and others cover MoTAT telematics. Was 4/10 in the first pass. Sources: https://www.cevreyazilimi.com/ , https://temsil.com.tr/ , https://seyirmobil.com/en/motat-mobile-hazardous-waste-transportation

name: GEKAP declaration tool
text: - **GEKAP declaration tool:** KPMG's GEKAP technology solution, ERP modules and accountants cover it. Was 3/10. Source: https://kpmgvergi.com/alt-hizmetler/vergi-teknolojileri/kpmg-gekap-teknoloji-cozumu-1041

name: HKS künye and hal-type e-invoicing for commission merchants
text: - **HKS künye and hal-type e-invoicing for commission merchants:** Atlas Hal, Kiraz Hal and Mikro Sinerji already integrate it; mandatory since 2014–2020. Sources: https://www.atlashal.com/ , https://www.mikrosinerji.com/sinerji-data-yazilim/blog/kurumsal-haberler/hal-kayit-sistemi-hks-nedir-yas-meyve-ve-sebze-ticaretinde-dijital-takip-sistemi/

name: U-ETDS freight notifications
text: - **U-ETDS freight notifications:** mature since 2020–21 with standard web-service integration (MDP Group and TMS vendors). Source: https://mdpgroup.com/blog/10-adimda-ulastirma-elektronik-takip-ve-denetim-sistemi-u-etds/

name: OSGB / İSG-KATİP software
text: - **OSGB / İSG-KATİP software:** Ministry-approved İBYS software has been mandatory since 2018 (eLogo İSG, MebISG). Source: https://www.ostim.org.tr/mebitech-bilisim-as/is-sagligi-ve-guvenligi-yazilimi , https://logo.com.tr/en/category/occupational-health-and-safety

name: Pharmacy İTS/MEDULA tooling
text: - **Pharmacy İTS/MEDULA tooling:** all of Turkey's roughly 29k pharmacies already run integrated programs (e.g. eczane.io). Source: https://www.medikalakademi.com.tr/teis-baskani-saydan-its-online-islemler-ekrani/
